substantive_approaches.result: All finite-degree projected derivatives of x^2 strictly negative; unregularized optimum -infinity; snapshot EDMD realization proved.
substantive_approaches.gap: Does not cover strict-feasible systems or every order of limits.

substantive_approaches.result: Weighted certified errors yield finite upper bounds and fixed-certificate consistency; coefficient-ball sensitivity inequality.
substantive_approaches.gap: Requires uniform generator-error bounds and an evaluable global maximum.

substantive_approaches.approach: Statistical least-squares and uniform approximation theory
substantive_approaches.result: Explicit Hoeffding/Gram-conditioning bound with projection, time-discretization and approximation error.
substantive_approaches.gap: Requires iid exact sites, conditioning and known approximation/regularity bounds; no generic rate for auxiliary approximation.

substantive_approaches.approach: Spatial covering and direct finite LP certificates
substantive_approaches.result: Data-only LP with known regularity and fill-distance margins converges beyond polynomial dynamics.
substantive_approaches.gap: Modified estimator; regularity and coverage information are necessary inputs.

substantive_approaches.result: Finite primal LP allows singular invariant measures and converges through weak compactness; explicit information-loss example.
substantive_approaches.gap: Dual to the fourth approach, not an independent algorithm; no necessary-and-sufficient characterization of the original scheme.
